run_googletest_output_test: run the googletest output test to verify Google Test text output matches the golden file
generate_golden_file: generate a new golden file by running the test with the --gengolden flag
normalize_test_output: normalize Google Test program output by removing locations, stack traces, and time info
remove_stack_traces: remove all stack trace details from a Google Test program's output using regex substitution
test_GTestOutputTest: test the GTestOutputTest class to compare normalized actual output against the golden file
